mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tw_h5_pay_order ( id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, mch_order_no VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, gateway_order_no VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, order_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, plan_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, recommendation_id VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL, vip_level INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, vip_days INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, usd_amount DECIMAL(18,6) NOT NULL, cny_amount DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT NULL, chain_key VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', coin VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USDT', expected_amount VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL, actual_amount VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL, pay_address VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT NULL, qr_content VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT NULL, deep_link VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT NULL, checkout_url VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT NULL, tx_hash VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT NULL, status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', fulfilled TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, expire_at BIGINT DEFAULT NULL, paid_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE KEY uk_mch_order_no (mch_order_no), KEY idx_user_created (user_id, created_at), KEY idx_gateway_order_no (gateway_order_no) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tw_h5_pay_order( mch_order_no, gateway_order_no, user_id, order_type, plan_code, title, recommendation_id, vip_level, vip_days, usd_amount, cny_amount, chain_key, coin, expected_amount, pay_address, qr_content, deep_link, checkout_url, status, fulfilled, expire_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{mchOrderNo}, #{gatewayOrderNo}, #{userId}, #{orderType}, #{planCode}, #{title}, #{recommendationId}, COALESCE(#{vipLevel}, 0), COALESCE(#{vipDays}, 0), #{usdAmount}, #{cnyAmount}, #{chainKey}, #{coin}, #{expectedAmount}, #{payAddress}, #{qrContent}, #{deepLink}, #{checkoutUrl}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'PENDING'), COALESCE(#{fulfilled}, 0), #{expireAt}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tw_h5_pay_order SET gateway_order_no = #{gatewayOrderNo}, chain_key = #{chainKey}, coin = #{coin}, expected_amount = #{expectedAmount}, pay_address = #{payAddress}, qr_content = #{qrContent}, deep_link = #{deepLink}, checkout_url = #{checkoutUrl}, expire_at = #{expireAt}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE mch_order_no = #{mchOrderNo}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tw_h5_pay_order WHERE mch_order_no = #{mchOrderNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tw_h5_pay_order SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at < #{nowMs}
UPDATE tw_h5_pay_order SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE mch_order_no = #{mchOrderNo} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE tw_h5_pay_order SET status = 'PAID', fulfilled = 1, gateway_order_no = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{gatewayOrderNo}, ''), gateway_order_no), chain_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{chainKey}, ''), chain_key), coin = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{coin}, ''), coin), actual_amount = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{actualAmount}, ''), expected_amount), tx_hash = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{txHash}, ''), tx_hash), paid_at = COALESCE(paid_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() WHERE mch_order_no = #{mchOrderNo} AND fulfilled = 0
